title: The Flash: The Fastest Man Alive – Official Movie Tie-In (Target Exclusive)
descriptionText:
The Flash: The Fastest Man Alive – Official Movie Tie-In (Target Exclusive Cover)
DC Comics (2023) | Writer: Kenny Porter | Artists: Ricardo López Ortiz, Juan Ferreyra, Jason Howard
Condition: Like New / Excellent
⚡ Description:
Witness Barry Allen’s early days as the Flash in this thrilling prequel to the 2023 Flash movie! This exclusive Target Edition features a variant cover by Scott Kolins, available only through Target stores.
After his harrowing adventure with the Justice League, Barry is determined to become the hero Central City deserves. When new villains emerge—including Girder, Tarpit, and The Top—the Scarlet Speedster seeks training from Batman himself to master the Speed Force. But even under the Dark Knight’s guidance, Barry struggles with the limits of his own powers.
📖 Collects:
The Flash: The Fastest Man Alive #1–3 (2022)
A thrilling, fast-paced story that bridges the gap between Justice League (2017) and The Flash (2023) movie—featuring appearances by Batman and set firmly within the DC Extended Universe timeline.
✍️ Creators:
Writer: Kenny Porter (DC: Mech)
Artists: Ricardo López Ortiz (Batman), Juan Ferreyra (Green Arrow, Gotham by Midnight), Jason Howard (Batman)
Colorists: Romulo Fajardo Jr., Juan Ferreyra, Jason Howard
Letterer: Steve Wands
Target Edition Cover Artist: Scott Kolins
Walmart Edition Cover Artist: Juan Ferreyra
📚 Book Details:
Publisher: DC Comics
Publication Date: 2023
Format: Softcover / Trade Paperback
ISBN: 978-1-77952-427-0 (Target Exclusive Edition)
Cover Price: $14.99 USD
Pages: Approx. 120
Genre: Superhero / Movie Tie-In
🦸 Condition:
Excellent, like-new condition
Tight spine, sharp corners, and glossy cover
Clean, unread interior pages
Stored carefully in a smoke-free, pet-free environment
